key.name: phonetic-only
key.description: When true, only the phonetic transliteration is shown. The dictionary candidate list is hidden, so 1–9 type Bangla numerals instead of picking a completion. Transliteration itself is unchanged.

key.name: candidates-horizontal
key.description: When true, the input method panel lays candidates out in a row (matching the macOS default). When false, in a column.

key.name: spelling-suggestions
key.description: When a word comes out spelled in a way the dictionary does not know (sonar gives সনার), list the dictionary's corrections (সোনার) after the typed word. Needs spell.db; without it nothing changes.

key.name: bangla-digits
key.description: When true, 0–9 typed outside the candidate list become Bangla numerals (1 gives ১). When false they stay 0–9. While the list is showing, 1–9 still pick a candidate either way.

key.name: qt-click-fix
key.summary: Qt apps: type a word once when clicking (older IBus)
key.description: Ubuntu 20.04 and 22.04 only (IBus older than 1.5.27, which cannot report the focused app). When true, IBus never commits the word being typed by itself, so Qt apps (KDE, Telegram, VLC) do not type it twice on a click; in GTK apps and browsers that word is dropped instead if you click away before Space. Ignored on newer IBus, which handles Qt automatically.

key.name: learn-words
key.summary: Learn from the words you pick
key.description: Suggestions you choose (number key, arrows and Enter, or a click) are counted, and words you pick often move up the list next time. The typed word stays first. Kept only on this computer, in ~/.local/share/byakaron/learned-words.txt; Settings can clear it.
